verses.text: The DOMNUL i-a zis lui Moise, Now you shall see what I will do to Faraon, for by a strong mână he shall let them să plece, and by a strong mână he shall drive them out of his țară.
Dumnezeu a vorbit lui Moise, and i-a zis lui him, Eu sunt the DOMNUL. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
I appeared to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, as Dumnezeu Almighty; but by my name the DOMNUL I was not known to them. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
I have also established my covenant with them, to give them the țară of Canaan, the țară of their travels, in which they lived as aliens.
Moreover I have heard the groaning of the children of Israel, whom the Egiptians keep in bondage, and I have remembered my covenant. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

Therefore tell the children of Israel, ‘Eu sunt the DOMNUL, and I will bring you out from under the burdens of the Egiptians, and I will rid you out of their bondage, and I will redeem you with an outstretched arm, and with great judgments. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

I will take you to myself for a people. I will be your Dumnezeu; and you shall know that Eu sunt the DOMNUL your Dumnezeu, who brings you out from under the burdens of the Egiptians. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
I will bring you into the țară which I swore to give to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob; and I will give it to you for a heritage: Eu sunt the DOMNUL.’
Moise spoke so to the children of Israel, but they didn’t listen to Moise for anguish of spirit, and for cruel bondage. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
The DOMNUL a vorbit lui Moise, saying, (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
Go in, speak to Faraon king of Egipt, that he let the children of Israel să plece out of his țară.

Moise spoke before the DOMNUL, saying, Behold, the children of Israel haven’t listened to me. How then shall Faraon listen to me, when I have uncircumcised lips? (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
The DOMNUL a vorbit lui Moise and to Aaron, and gave them a command to the children of Israel, and to Faraon king of Egipt, to bring the children of Israel out of the țară of Egipt.

These are the heads of their fathers’ houses. The sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel: Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi; these are the families of Reuben. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
The sons of Simeon: Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanite woman; these are the families of Simeon. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

These are the names of the sons of Levi according to their generations: Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari; and the years of the life of Levi were one hundred thirty-seven years. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
The sons of Gershon: Libni and Shimei, according to their families. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
The sons of Kohath: Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel; and the years of the life of Kohath were one hundred thirty-three years. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their generations. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

Amram took Jochebed his father’s sister to himself as wife; and she bore him Aaron and Moise. The years of the life of Amram were one hundred thirty-seven years. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
The sons of Izhar: Korah, and Nepheg, and Zichri. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
The sons of Uzziel: Mishael, Elzaphan, and Sithri. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
Aaron took Elisheba, the daughter of Amminadab, the sister of Nahshon, as his wife; and she bore him Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
The sons of Korah: Assir, Elkanah, and Abiasaph; these are the families of the Korahites. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

Eleazar Aaron’s son took one of the daughters of Putiel as his wife; and she bore him Phinehas. These are the heads of the fathers’ houses of the Levites according to their families. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
These are that Aaron and Moise to whom the DOMNUL a zis, Bring out the children of Israel from the țară of Egipt according to their armies.
These are those who a vorbit lui Faraon king of Egipt, to bring out the children of Israel from Egipt. These are that Moise and Aaron. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
On the day when the DOMNUL a vorbit lui Moise in the țară of Egipt,
The DOMNUL i-a zis lui Moise, Eu sunt the DOMNUL. Tell Faraon king of Egipt all that I tell you. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
Moise a zis before the DOMNUL, Behold, Eu sunt of uncircumcised lips, and how shall Faraon listen to me? (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

editorialNotes.resolutionReason: Deosebirea dintre revelarea ca El Shaddai patriarhilor și revelarea Numei de legământ YHWH.
